title: Gradient Breaker - Pictos Effect & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Gradient Breaker in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - what this Pictos does and exactly where to find it.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Flying Manor - Central Plaza merchant after the elevator, 97,800 Chroma

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Gradient Breaker is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: Increases Gradient Attack damage.

sections.title: How to Get Gradient Breaker
sections.content: Location: Flying Manor - Central Plaza merchant after the elevator, 97,800 Chroma.

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
